extras: Never publish your VK access token. Automatic synchronization runs only while the app is open.
problem: Users need a way to capture and organize messages from external social media platforms like VK within their Obsidian vault.

relations.evidence: The plugin can be used with Remotely Save or another vault synchronization method.

summary: VK Inbox imports private messages and voice notes from a VK community into a selected Obsidian note.
